modules.name: Full engine and game
modules.summary: Original Mario gameplay, assets, audio and editor hosted in Studio. Runtime and authoring scenes have separate lifecycles.

modules.name: World identity and persistence
modules.summary: All 1248 objects and 6085 components round-trip. UUIDs and animation graphs are preserved, including compound pillbox physics.

modules.name: Live actor controls
modules.summary: Local geometry controller uses real movement and jumping. Inputs have bounded tick leases; Escape and Take over release the agent.

modules.name: Autonomous editing
modules.summary: Model proposals go through registered operations, physics preview, revision checks, checkpointing and undo. Automatic application can be toggled.

modules.name: Sensory nervous system
modules.summary: Headless Hrm adaptation receives actual game features. LIF, sparse synapses, calcium, seeded noise, two-direction timing plasticity and JSON state are available.

modules.name: Measured policy improvement
modules.summary: Demonstration learning, held-out episodes, reward attribution, candidate comparison and evolution promotion remain future acceptance gates.
